and the re-derived zone, on standard traffic and on steady. Per period: the long-term effective

the penalty it adds; limit: the block's limit); the bodies listed past the penalty-free weight per

in SKL, and the penalty as a share of every listed fee; the pool's waiting count per block and its
drops (expired, evicted, refused) per block; the median count carried; the reward the blocks
minted per year (SKL) and the penalty as a share of it; every listed fee per block (SKL); the
Standard rung's ordinary body, its mean weight (KB) and its mean fee (SKL).
